Name: More Vanilla Table
Author: guxelbit
Description:
Just a simple mod that adds couple more table variant to the game.

"For now" it has :
• 3 tiles wide table
• Coffee table variant from other table
• Smaller dining table (2x2 just like normal table)

Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10505]GMCM[/url] to changes config 

You may use this as template or recolor, no need to ask, a credit is enough.
